NAME:
   rancher token - Legacy exec-credential shim for Rancher-generated kubeconfigs

USAGE:
   rancher token [flags]

FLAGS:
   --auth-flow flow      identity-provider flow
   --auth-provider name  auth config name to sign in with (for example corp-ldap); a provider name or type such as openldap also works; with several matches the CLI asks, or lists them in the error
   --cacerts path        PEM CA bundle path (legacy spelling of --cacert)
   --cluster id          cluster id for a cluster-scoped token (set by Authorized Cluster Endpoint kubeconfigs)
   --help, -h            show help
   --server url          Rancher server url (https assumed when schemeless)
   --skip-verify         skip TLS verification for a new sign-in and for reuse of the plugin login entry it saves (insecure)
   --user name           kubeconfig user name (as generated by Rancher)

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
